spans.s:
n. (-र्य्यं)
Heroism, prowess.
E.
शौटीर a hero, यत् aff.: see the next.

f. (-ता)
Valour, heroism.
E.
शौटीर a hero, तल् aff., and the diphthong changed to the short vowel.

r. 10th cl. (सुट्टयति)
1 To disregard, to despise.
2 To be small or shallow.

r. 10th cl. (सुट्टयति)
1 To disregard, to despise.
2 To be low, small, or shallow; also षुट्ट.
